purpose: Define which government opportunity sources are public, registration-gated, contract-holder-gated, or partially gated so MILES can maximize lawful coverage without misrepresenting access.

sources.name: GSA eBuy / eBuy Open
sources.notes: eBuy task-order/RFQ/RFP/RFI visibility is tied to authorized contractor access and applicable awarded categories/SINs. OASIS+ uses eBuy as the required task-order solicitation system.

sources.name: NITAAC e-GOS
sources.notes: NITAAC requires e-GOS for CIO-SP3 RFP/RFI distribution. Task orders under IDIQs generally are not required to be synopsized on SAM.gov.

sources.name: NASA SEWP Quote Request Tool / Contract Holder Portal (CHOP)
sources.notes: SEWP RFQ/RFI response tooling requires account access; contract-holder quote functions can require elevated permissions.
fallback: public SEWP catalog and scope data

sources.name: Army CHESS Digital Market / IT e-Mart RFx
sources.notes: CHESS RFQ/RFP/RFI and reverse-auction tools require login; many orders are competed among CHESS-authorized resellers or relevant vehicle holders.

sources.name: VA eCMS Vendor Portal
sources.notes: VA Vendor Portal requires vendor account registration tied to company/UEI for portal functions. VA FCO forecast search is public.
fallback: VA public Forecast of Contracting Opportunities

sources.name: DLA Internet Bid Board System (DIBBS)
sources.notes: Discovery should ingest public solicitation and award metadata. Login is required for quote submission and restricted portions; some technical data requires additional controlled access.

sources.name: DoD PIEE Solicitation Module
sources.notes: PIEE provides a public Solicitation Search, while vendor registration/roles are required for submissions and restricted content.

sources.name: FedConnect
sources.notes: MILES should ingest the public opportunity feed. Registered vendor access is needed for directed opportunities, awards, and messaging.

sources.name: Other agency/GWAC/MAC task-order portals
sources.notes: FAR 16.505 generally does not require synopsis of orders under indefinite-delivery contracts. Therefore many task-order opportunities are visible only to holders of the applicable IDIQ/MAC or ordering portal.
fallback: public justifications and award notices when required

sources.name: State/local hosted procurement portals and third-party bid platforms
sources.notes: Coverage must use a governed source-adapter registry rather than assume one national SLED API. Public pages/feeds should be collected where terms permit; account-only content must use authorized access or be explicitly labeled unavailable.
